title: Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building a small language model requires choosing which published improvements to combine. We compare five changes in the same model, using the same data and training budget. We test selected combinations and repeat each one with a second random seed. Mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimisation and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest gains. Extra normalisation also helps, while an attention gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The gains mostly combine, but small interactions between changes appear again in the repeated runs. Repetition also reveals benefits that an initial statistical estimate treated as noise. These findings apply to our small-model training setting; the expert models also have greater total capacity. The practical lesson is to test promising components together and repeat the comparisons before deciding which ones to keep.

translated_title: 前沿模型组件能否叠加生效？一项针对小语言模型的重复因子实验研究
translated_abstract: 构建小语言模型需要选择组合哪些已发表的改进方法。我们在同一个模型中使用相同的数据和训练预算，比较了五项改进。我们测试了选定的组合，并用第二个随机种子重复了每次实验。混合专家层、Muon 优化器和 Gated DeltaNet 混合架构带来了最大的增益。额外的归一化也有帮助，而在参数预算匹配的情况下，注意力门控平均而言几乎没有收益。这些增益大多可以叠加，但在重复实验中，各改进之间仍会出现微小的相互作用。重复实验还揭示了一些最初被统计估计视为噪声的收益。这些发现适用于我们的小模型训练设定；专家模型也拥有更大的总容量。实践中的经验教训是：在决定保留哪些组件之前，应当将最有前景的组件组合起来测试，并重复进行比较。
tldr: 该研究在相同数据和训练预算下通过重复因子实验比较了小语言模型的五项前沿改进，发现混合专家层、Muon 优化器和 Gated DeltaNet 混合架构收益最大且增益大多可叠加，强调在决定采用哪些组件前应组合测试并重复实验。
en_tdlr: This study uses replicated factorial experiments under identical data and training budgets to compare five frontier improvements in small language models, finding that mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimization, and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid yield the largest, mostly additive gains, and highlighting the practical lesson of testing promising components together and repeating comparisons before adoption.
